deployments_detail.use: "Cipla Genie" AI application in pharma manufacturing (Digital Lean team, awarded 2025); enterprise tech for manufacturing precision, QA, supply chain optimisation

Digital Automation Analytics (DAA) / Industry 4.0 program: AI/ML, advanced analytics, IIoT, NLP, RPA and robotics deployed across manufacturing operations. Its Indore OSD plant was inducted into the WEF Global Lighthouse Network for accelerated use of AI, with 30+ digital use cases scaled across 22 Indian sites. [In-house (WEF Global Lighthouse Network recognized)]
deployments_detail.value: 30+ use cases across 22 sites; ~23% higher productivity, ~28% reduction in greenhouse emissions

deployments_detail.use: CipAir, an AI-powered mobile app for first-line asthma screening. Uses a proprietary algorithm to turn a smartphone into a screening device, analyzing exhalation sounds for acoustic patterns indicative of asthma; clinically validated via a multi-centric pan-India study, delivered through the Breathefree platform. [Cipla (digital partner: Indus Net Technologies)]

Cipla Genie, an in-house Generative AI platform implemented at the Patalganga formulation plant by Cipla's Digital Lean team; recognized with the AI in Pharma Manufacturing Award at the 3rd Bharat Gen AI & Analytics Summit 2025. [In-house (Cipla Gen-AI Platform)]

AI-driven Quality Assurance: AI-based batch record review/automation, predictive maintenance, and real-time compliance dashboards in pharmaceutical manufacturing quality operations (described by a Cipla QA professional). [unspecified]

Conversational AI voice agents (Oration / OmniAgent) to conduct outbound patient surveys ahead of a new inhaler launch, gathering qualitative product feedback across six Indian languages (English, Hindi, Marathi, Tamil, Gujarati, Kannada). [Oration.ai / OmniAgent]
deployments_detail.value: 55% survey completion rate; 1-day deployment; thousands of patients contacted

deployments_detail.use: AI-generated, hyper-personalized celebrity/HCP videos (TrueFan AI) for Doctor's Day engagement, delivered to doctors across India by medical representatives. [TrueFan AI]
AI-driven job-shop scheduling at the Indore Lighthouse facility to optimize product changeovers and throughput in oral solid dosage manufacturing. [In-house]

'Driverless forecasting' at Cipla Medpro (South Africa): machine-learning/automated statistical demand forecasting to optimize inventory and reduce stock-outs across the pharmaceutical supply chain. [In-house supply chain analytics]
